name: Moss 口播剧组
look: Moss：moss01 LoRA 的金发人物（文章里训练的那个），主讲时是成年造型：黑色圆领上衣，锁骨下一枚细线月亮纹身
note: 首帧都用 scripts/moss_image.py 在 docker3 上出（Moss 加 moss01 LoRA，其他角色用底模），挑好放 assets/cast/。仓库原带的 assets/avatar_ref.jpg（白背心）是原作者的数字人，NOTICE.md 明确不许用在自己的内容里，只能当效果参考

voice.note: 每个角色的音色写在 hosts.<id>.voice，每段一字不改，整片音色才稳

h3.minutes_note: 实测：Turbo 8 步 480×864 · 7–9 秒一段约 2–4.5 分钟（单段执行 130–270 秒），双卡 25 段约 45 分钟；原版 20 步 1024×576 · 15 秒约 23 分钟

speed.note: H3 实测后再校准（看 cut/qa.json 的说话时长）

acts.pip: She talks to the camera like a friendly tech vlogger: warm eye contact, expressive eyebrows, small nods and one natural hand gesture near her chest.
acts.full: Warm eye contact, expressive face, natural hand gestures while explaining.
acts.scene: She speaks to the camera with confident, charismatic presence and a small natural gesture.

disclosure: 内容由 AI 数字人演绎

languages_tested.zh: 2026-10 H3 Turbo 实测 18 段，whisper 回听 79–100%（低分都是数字写法差异，不是念错）
languages_tested.note: 其他语言没测：先拍一段回听再批量

moss.name: Moss（主讲）
moss.who: the confident adult woman Moss in her late twenties with long loose wavy blonde hair, a fitted black scoop-neck top and a small fine-line crescent-moon tattoo on her upper chest
moss.voice: young adult woman with a warm, bright, slightly husky voice and lively pace
moss.sound: Quiet room tone with soft fabric rustle and natural breathing between phrases.

oliver.name: Oliver（黑框眼镜男搭档）
oliver.who: the witty young British man Oliver with round black-rimmed glasses, tousled dark brown hair and a charcoal knit sweater over a white shirt
oliver.voice: young British man with a dry, amused baritone voice and quick comic timing

hoot.name: Hoot 教授（猫头鹰）
hoot.who: the cute fluffy snowy owl Professor Hoot wearing tiny round gold glasses and a striped scarf, perched on a stack of old books
hoot.voice: small elderly owl professor with a soft, scratchy, cheerful voice
hoot.sound: Crackling candles, a soft page turn and a gentle feather ruffle.

chibi.name: Q 版 Moss（二次元）
chibi.who: the cheerful chibi anime witch girl with long wavy blonde hair, a dark green ribbon and a crescent-moon hairclip, holding a tiny glowing graphics card
chibi.voice: tiny, high-pitched, bubbly anime girl voice
chibi.sound: A sparkling magical chime and soft twinkles.
